blocks.text: Needs review by a South African attorney before use. This is a drafting outline, not legal advice and not an approved document. The statutes and instruments named are pointers for the reviewer: POPIA (Act 4 of 2013).

items: Use the platform for teaching, planning, assessment support and school administration.
Review every AI draft before it is used or shared.
Report anything that looks wrong or unsafe.
Type a learner’s name, ID number, contact details or other identifying information into an AI tool.
Share your login or use someone else’s.
Upload content you have no right to use.
Try to get around a safeguard, an approval step or an access limit.
Use the platform to harass, discriminate or harm.

blocks.text: Anything that affects a learner, a parent or a school record needs a person’s approval before it is final. The platform will not skip this step.
